title: r1 major UX: milestone-with-count budget cannot hold real names — the scoped gauge truncates away
description: Evidence: statusline-data.md:42 (width 24) vs this repo's live milestone names at 35-42 chars; tail-cut yields the name fragment and no count — the bounded gauge round 1 of the statusline amendment established (#331 resolution) is defeated in the normal case. Disposition: widen or split name/count fields AND state count-preservation-before-name as the truncation order (unstated today). Data-side. Owner: data-engineer. Validator: ux.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIX LANDED (commit e61f28e5, statusline-data 0.2.0): milestone-with-count width 24 to 34 (the session segment's freed 10); new truncation_rule field states count-preservation-before-name and the space-set-off mark — the bounded gauge survives real 35-42-char milestone names because the count always outlives the name. Round 2 re-verifies (validator: ux).
